THE FIRST NONTRIVIAL DIVISIBILITY LAYER IS EXACTLY SOLVABLE
Solo derivation, 31 October 2026. Builds on the preserved four-state root.

Let P_r be the COMPLETE stationary balanced binary Markov law with transition
eigenvalue-r,0<r<1: its flip probability is(1+r)/2. Define V_m as in PROOF.txt:
m times the minimum entropy per edge of a stationary standard-Borel hidden
kernel R whose observations every m steps have law P_r. Then

          V_1(P_r)=0,
          V_2(P_r)=2 phi(sqrt r)=4sqrt r atanh(sqrt r)>0.   (D1)

The second equality is an EXACT unrestricted-hidden-model result, including
the complete observed law, not a moment diagnostic or fixed hidden-count fit.

Lower bound. For any such root R, let C_j=E[f_0 f_j] at its fine grid.
C_2=-r, while its C_1 is unconstrained. Write u=Rf,v=R*f,a=(u+v)/2,t=(u-v)/2.
Then C_2=E(a^2-t^2), C_1=E(fa), and E t^2>=C_1^2-C_2>=r.
One direct derivation of e(R)>=phi(sqrt(E t^2)) uses the symmetrized edge
measure eta=(Gamma+Gamma^T)/2 and edge imbalance z=(Gamma-Gamma^T)/(Gamma+Gamma^T).
Conditional expectation gives t(x)=E_eta[z(x,Y)f(Y)|x]. Thus E t^2<=E_eta z^2.
Also e(R)=E_eta phi(z), and phi(sqrt s)=2sum_{k>=1}s^k/(2k-1) is convex
and increasing. Jensen gives e(R)>=phi(sqrt(E_eta z^2))>=phi(sqrt r).
Extended zero/support/infinite cases use the same limiting conventions as
the original entropy cone. Multiplying by2 proves V_2>=2phi(sqrt r).

Attainment. Put b=sqrt r and use the four-state kernel already constructed
in predictive_flow/PROOF.txt, states(s,t) in{+1,-1}^2, uniform stationary law:

 R((s,t),(s,-t))=(1+b s t)/2,
 R((s,t),(-s,t))=(1-b s t)/2.

It has Rs=b t, Rt=-b s and hence R^2s=-b^2s=-r s. Strong lumpability makes
the ENTIRE stride-two observed process the Markov law P_r, not just its
lag-two moment. Pairing the reciprocal edges gives e(R)=phi(b), proving
attainment in (D1). The root itself is periodic and is not claimed to be a
finite-CTMC sampled kernel. Its admissibility is at V_2's discrete-root scope.

Consequently every stationary all-even CTMC realization of P_r obeys the
sharper population lower bound

                 Delta*sigma_CT>=2phi(sqrt r).             (D2)

The virtual-midpoint implementation has limiting analytic witness rate4r,
slightly below(D1). For the frozen source r approximately0.042943,
4r/[2phi(sqrt r)] is approximately0.9855. This is a comparison to the EXACT
FIRST ROOT-LAYER min

source_excerpts.text:
STREAMING, TIME-UNIFORM ATTAINMENT OF THE EXACT FIRST ROOT LAYER
Solo derivation, 31 October 2026. Uses DIVISIBILITY.txt, not a CTMC-limit claim.

1. THE MISSING NONLINEAR WITNESS

The Gaussian midpoint cone recovers rate4r for the law P_r in DIVISIBILITY.txt.
Its exact first root-layer minimum is V_2=2phi(sqrt r), slightly larger.
The gap can be closed analytically without acquiring midpoints or solving
a predictive grid. Let g(s)=phi(sqrt s),0<=s<1. For any fixed rational
0<b<1, put

 lambda_b=g'(b^2)=atanh(b)/b+1/(1-b^2),
 c_b=lambda_b b^2-phi(b)=b^2/(1-b^2)-b atanh(b).             (S1)

Also allow b=0 with lambda_0=2,c_0=0. Convexity of g gives
phi(z)>=lambda_b z^2-c_b. Hence for every real t,

 phi*(2lambda_b t)<=sup_z[2lambda_b tz-lambda_b z^2+c_b]
                                       <=lambda_b t^2+c_b. (S2)

Replace the cross-phase payoff(V2) by

 H_b=2lambda_b d-lambda_b(t_x^2+t_y^2+a_x^2+a_y^2)-c_b.    (S3)

On cross-phase pairs its entropy-cone margin is at most-lambda_b a^2 by(S2).
Set it to0 on unsupported same-phase pairs. The antisymmetric bound is
M=2lambda_b. The exact two-edge identity is

 H_b(x,z)+H_b(z,y)=-2lambda_b f_x f_y-2c_b
       +lambda_b(u+f_x)(f_y-u)+lambda_b(v+f_y)(f_x-v).      (S4)

The two residuals have ranges<=4lambda_b, giving C=4lambda_b. The returning
kernel and full-path transfer therefore yield the finite-confidence bound

 Sigma_full>=-2lambda_b S_N-2N c_b
       -4lambda_b sqrt(2N log(1/alpha_m))
       -4N lambda_b^2 theta-log(1/alpha_e)/theta,           (S5)

for0<theta<=1/2, failure<=alpha_m+alpha_e. b is fixed before the record or
its selection is charged. (V5) is the b=0 specialization. The state-space
predictions remain different forward and backward fields and are not inputs.

2. A COMPLETE FAMILY FROM ONE SUFFICIENT STATISTIC

Predeclare b_1=0. Enumerate the remaining dyadic b's by increasing denominator:
1/2,1/4,3/4,1/8,3/8,5/8,7/8,... . Give witness j weight2^-j. At deterministic
checkpoint k with total inference risk a_k, evaluate the first
J_N=bit_length(N) witnesses at risks a_k 2^-j. Transport their maximum with
the SAME single future-descent budget d_k. All selections are charged.

sharp_midpoint.py encloses the log in(S1) with exact rational series. For
the observable term it uses the smaller endpoint of -2lambda_b S_N, an
upper c_b, and upper lambda_b in both noise costs. theta depends only on
N,b
